zh: 每次删掉两个相同字母，不会改变任何字母出现次数的奇偶性；所以最短结果里，出现奇数次的字母恰好各留一个，出现偶数次的字母全部删掉。
问题变成：从原串中给每个奇数次字母各选一个位置，使组成的子序列字典序最小，这正是经典的"去除重复字母取最小字典序"，用单调栈贪心。
先统计每个字母的总次数，确定哪些字母要保留。从左到右扫描并维护每个字母的剩余次数：跳过不需要保留或已在栈中的字母；否则当栈顶字母比当前字母大且后面还会再出现时，把栈顶弹出（并取消其在栈中的标记）；再把当前字母压栈。最后输出栈中字符串，可能为空行。
en: Deleting two equal letters never changes the parity of any letter's count, so a shortest result keeps exactly one copy of each letter with an odd count and none of the letters with an even count.

The task becomes choosing one position for each odd-count letter so that the resulting subsequence is lexicographically smallest, which is the classic smallest subsequence of distinct letters, solved greedily with a monotonic stack.

Count each letter to decide which letters are kept. Scan left to right while tracking each letter's remaining count: skip letters that are not kept or already on the stack; otherwise, while the top of the stack is larger than the current letter and appears again later, pop it and clear its on-stack mark; then push the current letter. Print the stack as a string, which may be an empty line.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Only letters that appear an odd number of times need to keep one copy each. After filtering out the other letters, use a monotonic stack to pick the lexicographically smallest subsequence without repeats.

## Proof of correctness

Deleting a pair does not change the parity of a frequency, so in a shortest result each odd-frequency letter keeps exactly one copy and no even-frequency letter is kept. As long as a larger letter on top of the stack still appears later, the smaller letter may enter first and that letter can be postponed; greedily choosing the smallest feasible prefix gives the smallest lexicographic order.

## Complexity

Time O(N), auxiliary character space O(26).
